note: Rule inspection (rule 7), finding for T-0021 from T-0023 (claude 17:20 run). Rule 11 asks for a metric, a script and a calibration (known match, known mismatch), but not that the game frame meets the conditions the calibration images had. T-0023's mirror ratio was calibrated on real lakes whose treeline box is a closed edge (sky share 0.000-0.002, refs/forest-edge/edge-gap.mjs); on the game frame that box is 12.2 % sky (refs/forest-edge/trunk-zone/results.jsonl), which inflates the denominator. Three runs and one box ruling (agy 13:42, which checked the water box by crop but not the treeline box) took 0.89 -> 0.82 as a near-pass; with the sky replaced in both boxes the same frames read 1.72. Proposal: rule 11 adds 'calibration preconditions: measure, on the game frame, the property that made the calibration images valid for each box or region (e.g. its class composition such as sky share); if it fails, the score is reported as invalid with the failing precondition, never as a pass or near-pass.' Evidence: tasks/handoffs/T-0023-claude.md (run 17:20), refs/water/optics-after7/ on claude/water-optics 95f1d41.
